Hi Marissa,

I downloaded the Redwood benchmark report earlier today (very helpful - thanks). Our team at Acme Analytics is evaluating inference platforms and I'd like to set up a short demo to see how Redwood's Dedicated offering would handle our throughput and latency requirements.

Quick context: we're running a mix of instruction-following and retrieval-augmented generation workloads, roughly 6-8M tokens/day across a small fleet of endpoints. Primary goals are predictable latency and cost control.

Are you available for a 30-min intro next week? I'm on PDT (San Francisco).

Thanks,
Jordan Smith
